thread:
ana_fin: Heads up — saw a spike in unbilled 'burst' events on acct_acme from 03/12 14:20-14:45. Looks like embeddings were processed but not counted as billable. Anyone seeing this on the metering side? :thinking:

tyler_recon: I noticed a similar pattern in the reconciliation queue. Opening TKT-5213 to track. Could be the new gateway burst path returning queued status while downstream processing completed without flipping the billing flag. Logs attached below.

mike_ops: We rolled a gateway change yesterday that added a 'burst-mode' enqueue path. It returns 202 and hands off to async workers. If billing_flag is only set at sync finalize, queued->processed flows might miss it.

jess_product: Customer (ACME) filed a support note — they expected higher embed counts on their bill, basically the opposite complaint. We need a triage and decision: backfill vs credit.

billing-bot: Invoice 2026-03-acme generated. Status: pending. Metering anomaly flagged (anomaly_id=MA-7721).

tyler_recon: Sample from the logs matching request ids: ```
2026-03-12T14:24:03Z request_id=req_abc123 acct=acct_acme embedding_units=250 tokens=0 billing_flag=false gateway_status=queued -> processed
2026-03-12T14:26:11Z request_id=req_def456 acct=acct_acme embedding_units=300 tokens=0 billing_flag=false gateway_status=queued -> processed
```

ana_fin (edit): small typo above - meant ana_fin.

ana_fin: Ok thanks. Does recon have a count of affected units?

tyler_recon: Prelim reconciliation shows 48 matching queued->processed requests in that window. That's ~12,000 embed units unbilled. I can export a CSV with request ids, timestamps, and unit counts for backfill.

mike_ops: We pushed a hotfix at 15:30 UTC to set billing_flag at enqueue time for now and added extra instrumentation. Full fix to ensure idempotent billing is queued for next week.

jess_product: Suggest we credit the current invoice and then backfill records so the usage appears correctly on the next invoice. That keeps ACME happy and avoids immediate overbilling.

ana_fin: I need formal approval from finance lead for the credit. Estimated credit approx ~$120 (12,000 units @ $0.01/unit). @matt_fin can you review and approve?

matt_fin: Approved. Please proceed with backfill and create a bill adjustment for the Mar 12 invoice. Add note: 'metering backfill for queued->processed misflag, Mar 12'.

ana_fin: Thanks — Tyler, can you attach the CSV to TKT-5213 and tag billing-ops so I can process the credit?

tyler_recon: CSV uploaded to TKT-5213 and assigned to billing-ops. Link: https://tickets.internal/TKT-5213 — included request_ids and unit counts. :white_check_mark:

jess_product: Also opening a short postmortem for the deploy change, tagging eng-runtime and eng-platform. Will include mitigation plan and timeline for the full fix.

anа_fin (final): Will process the invoice adjustment today and mark the invoice as adjusted in the ledger once billing-ops confirms the backfill applied. I will add the credit memo ref in the ticket.

(Note: small name glitch above — 'ana_fin' and 'ana_fin' variants consolidated in participants list.)
